correctness.rationale: For logits W h_theta, p_i^alpha normalized is exactly softmax(alpha W h)_i. With V=alpha W, d[alpha^-1 CE(alpha W,theta)]/dW=(p_alpha-y)h^T and d/dtheta=J_h^T W^T(p_alpha-y), matching the specified PowerGrad pseudo-backward rule in BOTH blocks. Transforming the update by V=alpha W yields eta_V=alpha eta_W and eta_theta^CE=eta_theta/alpha, hence exact ratio alpha^-2 for equal step sizes and identical fixed-feature class predictions. Independently checked random softmax probabilities, centered finite differences and 15 exact matched SGD steps. Alpha=0, non-linear final heads, optimizer momentum/adaptive state excluded.
